title: The Key
objectives_ko: 글자 J·K·L의 이름과 소리를 알고 말한다
J·K·L로 시작하는 단어 9개를 듣고 말하고 찾는다
사이트워드 and, in을 보고 읽는다 (C와 K는 같은 소리 /k/, 다른 글자임을 안다)

workbook.title: B. Circle the same letter.  C. Match and color.
D. Trace the words.  E. Color and say.
F. Read three times.  G. Sort the words.  H. Finish the story.

story.title: The Key

panels.desc: A big lemon tree in the Sound Garden. A grey koala hugs a branch and holds an old-fashioned golden key in its paw, smiling sleepily. A red diamond kite with a tail of bows is stuck in the branches, and a glowing golden seed sits on the kite. Bun and Hedgie stand under the tree looking up; Pip hovers near the kite, glowing. Hidden in the picture: the key in the koala's paw, the kite, the koala. On a small hill in the background, Grumble holds up a wooden sign painted with a big finger-over-lips pictogram (no letters), frowning; his lantern on the ground beside him glows softly.

lines.text: The seed is in the kite.

panels.ko: 레몬나무의 코알라가 황금 열쇠를 들고 있어요. 연에 씨앗이 걸렸어요. 그럼블은 "조용!" 그림 팻말을 들었어요.

panels.desc: A picnic table in the garden. A big glass jar of wobbly red jelly stands on the table and a glowing golden seed is sunk inside the jelly; a glass of orange juice with a straw stands beside it. Hedgie peers into the jar with his nose on the glass. Pip is trying to say a sound but instead just jumps: it is caught mid-air high above the table with its feathers flying, little motion lines under its feet. Bun laughs and claps. Behind them the new K letter tree with key-, kite- and koala-shaped fruits. Hidden in the picture: the jelly, the juice, Pip jumping. Grumble does NOT appear.

lines.text: The seed is in the jelly!

panels.ko: 젤리 병 속에 씨앗이 있어요. 핍은 /j/ 소리 대신 펄쩍펄쩍 뛰기만 해요.

panels.desc: Under the lemon tree again. A bright yellow lemon with a leaf has just dropped from the branch and split open, and a glowing golden seed shines inside it. Bun catches the lemon in her paws; Hedgie licks his lips and puckers at the sour smell; Pip glows above. Hidden in the picture: a scarecrow by the tree with one striped-sock leg kicked out, a golden padlock hanging on a small round wooden door in the garden wall behind the tree. In the far corner, Grumble peeks from behind the lemon tree trunk still holding his finger-over-lips sign, but he is leaning in to listen; his lantern glows a little brighter.
panels.ko: 레몬이 뚝 떨어져 갈라지자 안에 씨앗이! 헤지는 신 냄새에 얼굴을 찡그려요. 담장에 자물쇠 달린 문이 보여요.

ask.en: What is on the little door?

panels.desc: The garden wall with a small round wooden door. Hedgie turns the golden key in the golden padlock and the door swings open, showing a dark blue starry night garden on the other side. Bun is already jumping through the doorway with one boot in the air; Pip flutters after her. Three new letter trees (J with jelly, juice and jump fruits; K with key, kite and koala fruits; L with lemon, leg and lock fruits) stand behind them. Grumble pops out of a dirt hole right beside the door; his finger-over-lips sign lies flat on the ground like a doormat and he is staring at the open door with his mouth open; his lantern glows warm and bright. Hidden in the picture: the padlock, the golden key in Hedgie's paw.
panels.ko: 열쇠로 자물쇠를 열자 문이 열려요. 문 너머는 깜깜한 밤 정원! 그럼블의 팻말은 바닥에 떨어졌고, 등불은 더 밝아졌어요.

story.synopsis_ko: 코알라가 열쇠를 쥐고 있어요. 연과 젤리 병, 레몬에서 씨앗을 찾았어요. 열쇠로 자물쇠를 열자 두 번째 정원 문이 열렸어요! 그럼블의 "조용" 팻말은 발닦개가 됐어요.
story.so_far_ko: 염소가 삼킨 씨앗을 되찾고 G·H·I 나무를 키웠어요.
story.goal_ko: 씨앗 세 개와 열쇠를 찾아 둘째 정원의 문을 열어요.

videos.prompt: Gentle picture-book animation: the red kite flutters in the lemon tree, the golden seed on it twinkles, the koala blinks slowly and dangles the golden key which glints in the sun; the rabbit and the hedgehog look up with wonder. Camera still. Soft, child-friendly. No text.

Gentle picture-book animation: the lemon drops from the branch and splits open, the golden seed inside sparkles, then with a soft POP a small cheerful letter tree sprouts up beside the lemon tree and grows quickly, lemon-shaped fruits swinging; the baby bird glows. Camera still. Child-friendly. No text.

pages.desc: A big lemon tree. A grey koala hugs a branch holding a golden key; a red kite with a glowing seed is stuck in the branches. Bun and Hedgie look up; Pip hovers by the kite. On a hill behind, Grumble holds up a wooden sign painted with a big finger-over-lips pictogram, frowning hard; his lantern on the ground glows softly.
pages.ko: 레몬나무의 코알라가 열쇠를 들고, 연에는 씨앗이 있어요. 그럼블은 '조용' 그림 팻말을 들었어요.

pages.desc: A picnic table with a big jar of wobbly red jelly, a glowing seed sunk inside, and a glass of orange juice. Hedgie presses his nose to the jar. Pip tries to say a sound but just jumps — frozen mid-air above the table with feathers flying. Bun claps. Behind a bush Grumble holds his quiet sign upside down, peeking over it; his lantern glows soft.

lines.text: The seed is in the jelly!

pages.ko: 젤리 병 속에 씨앗이 있어요. 핍은 /j/ 대신 펄쩍펄쩍 뛰어요. 그럼블은 팻말을 거꾸로 들었어요.

pages.desc: A yellow lemon has dropped and split open showing a glowing seed; Bun catches it; Hedgie puckers at the sour smell. Behind the tree, a small round wooden door in the garden wall with a golden padlock, and Hedgie's key already in the lock: the door is opening onto a dark blue starry night garden. A scarecrow with one striped-sock leg stands by the tree. Grumble's quiet sign lies flat on the ground like a doormat and Grumble pops out of a hole beside the door, mouth open; his lantern glows warm and brighter.
pages.ko: 레몬에서 씨앗이 나와요. 열쇠로 자물쇠를 열자 밤의 정원이 보여요. 팻말은 발닦개가 됐어요.
